lines.t: 💛 You hold Seed packet. Pressed into your hand with an order: keep people fed through winter. Seeds are a plan. Plans are how you stop being helpless. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are still yours. The feast was the weapon.
You coax 4 growing beds forward by 12 days. The next harvest carries the growth magic.
You call a moot on it. The fire gets built up. The petitioners sit just outside the light, trying not to look like they're listening.
Tamika stands. "They EAT people. I don't care how hungry the road made them. No."
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken.
Frank counts on their fingers, twice. Then, to the fire: "1 for taking them in. 10 against."
The moot votes no. Sanne nods like they expected it. "Thanks for the fire, anyway." They walk.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Word will travel: Haven is clean hands. (Opinion +2 with every village that knows you.)
🔥 The beacon catches. Smoke climbs — black, deliberate, readable for miles. Every fire in range will see it.
"Our foragers leave our fields," says Hana Osei of Emberhold. "3 of us — give us 2 day-parts. Remember it: 3,600 kcal of work, or the trust of it."
"Our foragers can't leave the fields — not for this," says Deshawn. (Refused — the ask didn't carry.)
"Our foragers leave our fields," says Marcus Rhee of Stonebridge. "3 of us — give us 2 day-parts. Remember it: 3,600 kcal of work, or the trust of it."
Something in the treeline reads smoke as well. The door just got more crowded — and while the beacon's attention holds, slipping away isn't an option.
You walk to the trap line with Naran. Nothing much there — but they talk the whole way, and you learn the shape of them a little better.
📓 Codex: Naran picked up Loud Chewer from talking with you — what it does, and what it might go with.
